segments.ja338:1.1: Viditaṃ thusaṃ undurānaṃ [undūrānaṃ (ka.)], viditaṃ pana taṇḍulaṃ;
segments.ja338:1.3: Thusaṃ thusaṃ [thusaṃ thūlaṃ (sī.)] vivajjetvā, taṇḍulaṃ pana khādare.
segments.ja338:2.1: Yā mantanā araññasmiṃ, yā ca gāme nikaṇṇikā;
segments.ja338:2.3: Yañcetaṃ iti cīti ca, etampi viditaṃ mayā.
segments.ja338:3.1: Dhammena kira jātassa, pitā puttassa makkaṭo;
segments.ja338:4.3: Yopāyaṃ heṭṭhato seti [sesi (sī.)], etampi viditaṃ mayāti.
